estimand_contract.unit_span: One complete affirmative structural-conformance or policy-admission message with identical item and named rule references.
estimand_contract.contrast: Marked wording minus concise complete English: X parses and satisfies S's structural rules; P permits X to proceed. Both sides refer to the same immutable item, versioned rule and single stated gate; neither implies truth, safety, issuer authority or successful execution.
estimand_contract.population: 128 authored messages: 64 structural-conformance statements and 64 policy-admission statements, eight per form in each of eight equally weighted domains (API, configuration, data import, ballots, grant applications, moderation, deployment, procurement). One fixed renderer per form; not a random natural-usage population.

aggregation.rule: Equal item means within each of two equally weighted predicate strata, then maximum tokenizer mean over the three declared encodings. Report both form strata and retain the complete form-by-tokenizer matrix; domain variation is diagnostic.

manifest.shared_reference_context: These are fictional statements, not actual authorisations or validator outputs. Within each pair X names one immutable unconverted item, S names its parsing and structural schema, and P names the policy applicable at the single gate being discussed. Each reference uniquely resolves in that fictional record; the two arms share the same gate and instant. The structural pair stipulates actual conformance, not merely a possibly faulty PASS log. The policy pair stipulates permission to proceed through that gate, not mere ALLOW output or successful subsequent execution. No policy implies a particular schema unless stated, and no extra implication is stated in these cost records. Context is identical metadata for both arms and is not counted on either side.
manifest.comparator_review: Two concise ordinary-English templates chosen before counting. Their affirmative content matches the registered predicates; absence of a truth, safety, authority, execution or future-validity assertion is preserved in both arms. No extra disclaimer paragraph is charged to English and no fact is withheld from it. This is not proof of global shortest wording. The policy template's named policy supplies permission, not epistemic possibility. Gate identity is shared context, not a hidden extra assertion in one arm.
manifest.scope_limits: Token prerequisite only. Covers eight listed domains, not all possible domains or negative predicates. Repeated item names across the two forms are a paired authored design, not 128 independent semantic worlds. No bare valid comparator, ambiguous-status reader contrast, four-state comprehension coverage or new training-efficiency claim.
manifest.selection: One prospectively authored fresh bank of 128 pairs, eight items per form in each source domain. Fresh lexical base names and all references. Exact source templates, estimand, shared context, equal form/domain allocation and named encodings preserved. Freeze before loading tokenizers; retain first finite result regardless of direction, without token-guided edits or redraws.
manifest.prediction_before_count: The source has a positive pooled cost and different predicate costs. No exact replication outcome is assumed; numeric agreement and satisfying the +4 allowance will be assessed separately.

freshness_audit.semantic_review: Every pair retains one immutable unconverted item, identical versioned schema or policy and shared single gate and instant. Affirmative conformance and permission are stipulated, not inferred from fallible PASS/ALLOW logs. Neither arm adds truth, safety, issuer authority, execution or indefinite-validity claims. Same source renderers and shared-reference context; no hidden premise only in one arm.
freshness_audit.limits: 64 new fictional items, each expressed under both predicates. One renderer per form; not 128 independent semantic worlds, a natural-usage sample, proof of shortest English, a reader test or empirical validator audit.

comparison_identity.comparator: Marked wording minus concise complete English: X parses and satisfies S's structural rules; P permits X to proceed. Both sides refer to the same immutable item, versioned rule and single stated gate; neither implies truth, safety, issuer authority or successful execution.
comparison_identity.population: 128 authored messages: 64 structural-conformance statements and 64 policy-admission statements, eight per form in each of eight equally weighted domains (API, configuration, data import, ballots, grant applications, moderation, deployment, procurement). One fixed renderer per form; not a random natural-usage population.
comparison_identity.aggregation: Equal item means within each of two equally weighted predicate strata, then maximum tokenizer mean over the three declared encodings. Report both form strata and retain the complete form-by-tokenizer matrix; domain variation is diagnostic.
comparison_identity.unit_span: One complete affirmative structural-conformance or policy-admission message with identical item and named rule references.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
